prompt: I already have Hyprland configured but my waybar looks boring — it's just a flat grey bar with plain text. I want a modern floating pill bar with Gruvbox Dark colors, icons for each module, and a power button. Desktop, no battery needed. Just give me the waybar config.jsonc and style.css.

assertions.text: style.css defines Gruvbox Dark colors (e.g. #282828, #ebdbb2, #fb4934, #b8bb26, #fabd2f, #83a598, or similar gruvbox palette)
config.jsonc does not include a battery module (user said desktop, no battery)
style.css creates a floating pill effect (transparent waybar background + rounded containers)
config.jsonc uses icon characters in module format strings (not plain text like 'Volume:' or 'CPU:')
Output contains only waybar config.jsonc and style.css (not a full Hyprland config set)
